title: InfoRM: Mitigating Reward Hacking in RLHF via Information-Theoretic Reward Modeling

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating and comparing the average response lengths of the models at different RLHF training steps across diverse datasets to evaluate the model's erroneous tendency to equate longer responses with higher reward quality.

Qualitative evaluation of model outputs using case studies to identify and measure the phenomenon where models exhibit overly cautious refusals to respond to benign prompts due to overoptimization on harmful data.
